output_list.criticism: The div10 function is vulnerable to integer overflow. The function takes an integer input and divides it by 10, which can result in an overflow if the input is too large. This vulnerability can be exploited by an attacker to manipulate the contract's state and potentially gain control over the contract.

The lockBalances function is accessible to anyone and allows the owner to lock the balance of an arbitrary user. This vulnerability can be exploited by an attacker to lock the balance of a malicious user and potentially gain control over the contract.

The setExportFee function is accessible to anyone and allows the owner to set the export fee. This vulnerability can be exploited by an attacker to set the export fee to a high value and potentially gain control over the contract.

The setHoldingPeriod function is accessible to anyone and allows the owner to set the holding period. This vulnerability can be exploited by an attacker to set the holding period to a short value and potentially gain control over the contract.
